rules.golden_bunch: creator has at least 2 E4 wins and 0 E4 losses; chosen implementation rule because no prior numeric threshold was frozen
rules.hg_import_policy: terminal workflow checkpoints only; CLOSED paper positions plus explicit rejections; observer-only accounts excluded
rules.losses_after_exit: explicit observed post-exit evidence says price went lower after exit
rules.unknown_policy: missing outcome/post-exit evidence remains UNKNOWN and is never inferred
rules.wins_after_exit: explicit observed post-exit evidence says price went higher after exit
